corrections: Load-bearing NET-CASH figure overstated. Bear/dossier cite 'net cash RMB 505.27B (cash 510.37B vs debt 5.10B).' The RMB ~505B aggregate only reconciles by adding non-current time deposits/HTM/AFS securities (~RMB 95.2B in 'other non-current assets') and/or restricted cash (RMB 76.2B) -- i.e. it counts non-liquid/restricted buckets as 'cash.' DIRECTION is robustly true (fortress net cash, ~zero debt, cash is a majority of implied EV), but the clean liquid net-cash number is ~RMB 436B, not RMB 505B -- the SoP cash add-back should be haircut accordingly.
